$comment: Where each piece of static Unbound game data comes from and how far it has been verified. Player/run data never goes here. Checked by test/data/unbound-contract.test.mjs.

routes.description: Route order, per-location encounter species lists and boss placement
routes.source: Inherited from upstream nuzlocke.app (domtronn/nuzlocke.app); original source not recorded
routes.notes: Species lists only (no method, levels or rates). Route names are tracker record keys - see test/data/unbound-route-keys.json.

bosses.description: Gym leaders, rivals (starter variants), Elite Four, Champion, Ruin/Shadow admins, Successor Maxima - Normal and Expert
bosses.source: Inherited from upstream nuzlocke.app; cards cite https://www.pokecommunity.com/showthread.php?t=382178 only
bosses.notes: static/api/league files are generated from league.json (forms dropped from names); the contract test checks they match.

patches.description: Unbound-specific moves (Hidden Power types, Leech Fang, Metal Bash) and abilities (Portal Power, Royal Roar, Cotton Cloud, Bellow)
patches.source: Inherited from upstream nuzlocke.app; original source not recorded
patches.notes: Species, item and fakemon patches are empty: the tracker uses unmodified base species data.

levelCaps.description: Capped Exp. Share level caps for Difficult and higher (used for both Normal and Expert runs)

sources.name: PokeCoders - Level Caps in Pokemon Unbound Explained

levelCaps.notes: Both sources give identical values for 0-8 badges and the post-Tarmigan cap (45); the wiki says caps are removed at Champion. PokeCoders names the milestone 'Tarmigan Mountain', the wiki 'Tarmigan Mansion' (routes.json places Successor Maxima at 'Tramigan Mansion'; not yet confirmed to be the trigger). The sources may not be independent. No documented save flag for the milestone, so the app shows both values at 4 badges. Replaces PUSE's unsourced tables; PUSE's 'normal' table matched except for the missing milestone, and its 'expert' table contradicted both sources.

speciesNames.description: Save species ids -> names/forms, save layout
speciesNames.notes: PUSE's levelCap.js / unboundLevelCaps data are no longer used (see levelCaps).
